Isle Be Back

5 Bedrooms 5 Full Bathrooms 2 Half Bathrooms 12 Sleeps Destin

Home Highlights
- Private Resort Style Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $90 per day between Oct 1-May 1)
- Waterfront
*The Dedicated Boat Slip is directly behind the home in the Destin Harbor Canal*
- Brand New Construction
- Steps from Beach Access
- Gulf Views
- Six Seater Golf Cart
- Six Bikes Included
- Elevator

Welcome to a brand-new waterfront retreat in the heart of Holiday Isle, where luxury, location, and effortless coastal living come together. Set along the Destin Harbor Canal, this newly constructed home offers waterfront living with Gulf views, steps-from-the-beach access, and direct boating access to Destin’s most iconic spots.
The outdoor space is designed for fun and relaxation, featuring a private resort-style pool, turf putting green, and outdoor family games—perfect for laid-back afternoons and evening gatherings.
Boaters will appreciate the dedicated private boat slip located directly behind the home, accommodating boats up to 50 feet with quick access to the Harbor and Crab Island. The canal also allows for easy paddleboard and kayak access right from the backyard.
Inside, bright modern interiors span multiple levels with the convenience of an elevator. An upstairs family room with TV and mini kitchen opens to a large upper balcony with beautiful water and Gulf views, an ideal space to unwind after a day on the water.
With a six-seater golf cart, six adult bikes, and an unbeatable location, this Holiday Isle waterfront home offers a seamless blend of adventure and relaxation, perfect for an elevated Destin getaway.
